title: Idempotence of an equal-length tape patch
statement: Let $K\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\Gamma$ and $P$ be types, let $x$ be a word over $\Gamma$, and let $d$ be a configuration with $K+1$ work tapes and state set $P$. Given states $q,q'\in P$ and lists of fields $f_s,g_s$ over $\Gamma$, suppose their joined words have equal lengths. Patching $d$ with $f_s$ and state $q$, then patching the result with $g_s$ and state $q'$, gives the same configuration as patching the original $d$ with $g_s$ and state $q'$. Each patch sets the state and overwrites work tape $0$ on the interval beginning at its current head position whose length is the length of the joined fields, leaving all other configuration data unchanged.
